items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: Harold is a fine teller. He's a good man.

ctx.x: Yes, I'm just saying. You know all those times? No, but Harold tells me about him. He's going to, uh, he's going to introduce me to them all. Oh, I understand. Oh, who is it Harold?
Don't know. Yeah. I don't know. Harold is a fine teller. He's a good man. He's been born by everybody.

Yeah, he's always nice, Harold Desjardins. If you ever meet him. We have a man. You'll meet him someday, you know. I've been hoping he'd get on Soprano too. You know, I wanted to spread the work around a little more and that guy down there, I guess he'd give you some work to those people in the quarter. You know, if you could get to Soprano. Ian Harold, that man would make quite a novelty now.
